retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, high-key portrait layout featuring a vertically oriented name and a boxed logo-mark against vast white negative space.
triggerTerms: asymmetric face crop with white space

recipe.visualDefinition: An extreme close-up of a face, heavily overexposed to eliminate mid-tones and skin texture, leaving only the eyes, eyebrows, and lips visible in a warm sepia-black. The subject is pushed to the right, balanced by a stark white field on the left containing vertically stacked, widely tracked serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Balance between detailed facial features and empty white negative space
Vertical text alignment echoing the verticality of the face crop
Monochromatic sepia-toned features against a pure white background
Geometric contrast between the organic face and the rigid boxed logo
coreInvariants: High-key exposure blowing out skin detail

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Extreme close-up of a face occupying the right two-thirds of the frame, cropped at the forehead and chin.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, detailed eyes and eyebrows serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer starts at the eyes, moves down to the lips, then follows the vertical text line on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dominant white space on the left third of the composition, providing breathing room for typography.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm Cream (Mid-tones in lips and eyes)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation, extreme value contrast between highlights and shadows.

letterConstructionRules: Vertical orientation with characters rotated 90 degrees or stacked
Thin, elegant hairlines and thick stems
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in different scales and orientations.
graphicDevices: Double-bordered rectangular frame for secondary text

candidateDirections.reason: Classic high-contrast serif with vertical stress.
Elegant, fashion-forward aesthetic with sharp terminals.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key, overexposed sepia-toned portrait of a face, cropped tightly on the right side. Ensure the left third of the image is pure white negative space with no texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add vertical uppercase serif text in the left white space with wide tracking. Place a small double-bordered box at the bottom left containing stacked serif text.

verificationChecks: Is the skin texture almost entirely blown out to white?
Is there a significant amount of empty white space on the left?
Are the facial features (eyes, lips) sharp and high-contrast?

adjustableVariables: Amount of tracking in the vertical text
Thickness of the logo box border
postGenerationChecks: Check for pure white background on the left
Ensure text does not overlap the face
Verify the vertical stacking of letters is legible
Confirm the sepia tone is consistent across features and text
recipe.reuseFormula: High-key portrait + Vertical Serif Typography + Asymmetric White Space = Minimalist Editorial Aesthetic
